sentences.text:
Petitioner :- Riyazuddin
Respondent :- State Of U.P. And 3 Others
Counsel for Petitioner :- Yash Pratap Singh,Monika Pal

Counsel for Respondent :- C.S.C.
Hon'ble Manoj Misra,J.
Hon'ble Jayant Banerji,J.
The petitioner is aggrieved by an order of the Adjudicating Authority imposing penalty on the petitioner under Section 51 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.
Admittedly, the petitioner can file an appeal before the Food Safety Appellate Tribunal constituted under Section 70 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.
In view of existence of an alternative remedy, we decline to entertain this petition by leaving it open to the petitioner to avail alternative statutory remedy.
With the aforesaid liberty, the writ petition is disposed of.
